title: Hotels with a Taipei 101 view: which room to book
metaDescription: Five Taipei hotels with rooms facing Taipei 101, the exact room category to book at each, and the look-alike rooms that look at the city or the river instead.
h1: Hotels with a Taipei 101 view, and which room to book
dek: Five hotels in Taipei, in Xinyi and Songshan. For each one we list the room category sold with the tower in sight, and the look-alike rooms that do not name it.
teaser: From a hotel with three categories named for the tower to one that sells it inside a suite.

faq.q: Which Taipei hotels sell rooms with a Taipei 101 view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026: Shangri-La Far Eastern and amba Taipei Songshan sell categories with 101 in the name. W Taipei, Le Méridien Taipei and Illume Taipei describe the tower in a suite.

faq.q: Do all rooms at these hotels see Taipei 101?
faq.a: No. Taiwan Obsessed says only certain rooms at W Taipei have the view. Amba says most of its rooms see the tower or the Keelung River, so book the category with 101 in the name.

faq.q: Is a city view the same as a Taipei 101 view?
faq.a: Not by name. Shangri-La sells its Horizon Deluxe Rooms with views of the tower or the city. If you want the tower, book a category that names it.
